scope: Behavior, ARIA, parts, events, delays and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup. Placement, rendered lengths and motion are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: preset and parts anatomy, role=tooltip and aria-describedby, hover delay, warm group (no delay, data-instant), keyboard focus and blur, press and Escape close, disabled, openchange reasons, hover intent and arrow placement, no native form elements
resolvePopup('tooltip'): 7u text row, padding, radius, 60u cap, no trigger-width minimum
React SSR: the same data-* and recipe classes as the web component on host and parts, the preset renders its parts (the child as the trigger), Provider

limitations: Placement, the top layer, :focus-visible and the reveal motion need a real browser; unit tests cover the attributes they key on.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).

The web component has no provider element: every ui-tooltip shares one warm group with Base UI's default timeout (400 ms); per-tooltip delay and close-delay attributes set the delays. React Tooltip.Provider sets them for a subtree.
Cursor tracking (Base UI trackCursorAxis) and one popup for several triggers (handles, payloads) are not implemented.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio Chromium at u = 3, 4, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, light and dark): growth (a long tooltip wraps at 60u and grows in height; the 7u row is its single-line height), RTL (start / end alignment mirrors through the logical anchor rule; the arrow offset is measured), focus (the tooltip takes no focus; the trigger's ring is unchanged), screenshots of the Popups family and the size ladder checked light and dark (inverse fill reads in both).
